interpretation: Sparse witness patches defined from source photos and task instructions, not full segmentation masks. Version 2 sets blue to the conventional royal-blue hue (225 degrees) after development inspection; all regions and scalar choices were fixed before inspecting heldout candidates or scores. Failed witnesses expose specific violations; passed witnesses cannot certify the whole image.
combination: For supported color tasks, take the minimum of normalized EditScore overall, mean target-color membership, and one minus maximum positive target-color leakage into protected patches. Other task types retain the original reward. No thresholds are tuned on heldout outputs.

armchair_seat_blue.crop_instruction: Change only the seat surface of the large armchair to royal blue. Keep its entire curved backrest and both armrests grey. Keep the separate brown magazine holder on the left and the black side table unchanged.

sweater_one_sleeve.crop_instruction: Change only the sleeve on the left side of this image, on the arm holding the gift box, to royal blue. Keep the torso and other sleeve red. Keep all white printed lettering and patterns and the gift box unchanged.

far_chair_blue.crop_instruction: Recolor only the farther chair behind the white table royal blue. Keep the nearer foreground chair rust-colored. Preserve chair shapes, fabric textures and the white table.

dining_left_teal.crop_instruction: Change only the left chair seat and back upholstery to teal blue fabric. Keep its cream wooden frame unchanged. Keep the entire right chair, including burgundy upholstery, and the white table unchanged.

dining_left_seat_blue.crop_instruction: Change only the left chair seat cushion to royal blue. Keep its backrest burgundy and frame cream. Keep the entire right chair burgundy and the white table unchanged.

far_chair_seat_blue.crop_instruction: Recolor only the seat cushion of the farther chair behind the white table royal blue. Keep that chair backrest rust-colored. Keep the entire nearer foreground chair rust-colored and the white table unchanged.

color_reference: Royal blue uses the conventional #4169E1 swatch hue (~225 degrees); teal uses #008080 (~180 degrees). Broad hue tolerance accommodates shading. Version 2 corrects the pure-blue/royal-blue distinction using development data before heldout generation/scoring.
